issues.issue: 784 inputs to 100 biased dense units gives 78,500 parameters, not over a million. Flattening retains values while changing spatial inductive bias. CNN is an ANN subtype; overfitting is not guaranteed by count alone.
The RPN belongs to Faster R-CNN, not Fast R-CNN; selected historical milestones do not establish first-ever invention. YOLOv1 preprint appeared in 2015, conference in 2016.
W,H,C is not a universal API axis order, and vision/CNN superiority claims are task-dependent.

The plus-offset formula is cross-correlation under mathematical convention, commonly called convolution in neural-network APIs. Padding preserves size only with suitable stride/kernel/dilation settings.
Fixed average pooling is linear; max pooling is not. Neither introduces trainable weights in the stated standard form.
Sigmoid can support independent multilabel outputs; softmax fits a mutually exclusive class distribution.
Displayed scores are not dataset accuracy or measured IoU; box encodings require an explicit position convention.
Original YOLOv1 coordinate, confidence and per-cell class-vector conventions are not interchangeable with later YOLO versions.
NMS is not one global winner; class policy, overlap and threshold determine suppression. 98 candidates do not imply 98 true objects.
Malformed class legend text remains a transcription limitation, not invented taxonomy.
A selected version table does not prove universal performance ranking or exhaust all versions/authors; batch normalization is not hard clipping.
Anchor-free removes predefined box shapes, not spatial reference points; actual box decoding includes extent, not only a center.
The reproduced four-branch figure is not the standard three-scale P3/P4/P5 YOLOv8 detection configuration.
Semantic features do not imply masks, and YOLOv1 objectness×IoU should not be imposed on the different YOLOv8 head.
Code is an inference excerpt, not training; uncached weights and URL input require network. Additional reporting code is needed for the shown formatted box list.
Printed scores/coordinates are rounded observations from an unpinned run; reproduced output does not establish detection truth or general accuracy.
